description: Agent-mode code review of uncommitted local changes (git diff HEAD, plus new files git does not ignore). Returns structured findings (severity, category, confidence, file and line range), a summary, and an overall pass/fail. Prefer this when a coding agent holds the working copy and will act on the findings. Optionally pass `relatedPaths` (extra context files beyond the diff) and `diagnosticsPath` (a local tsc/eslint output file). On changes of 200 or more changed lines, a context step first asks Optibot which other repository files the review needs, reads them from the working copy, and sends them with the review; the step and the review count as one review, and `meta.scout` reports what it sent. Pass `scout: false` to skip it. When a run reports "Missing context", re-call this tool with those paths in `relatedPaths`. Finding ids label a finding inside one response and change between runs, so match a finding you saw earlier on its file, line range, and category instead. A `suggestedFix` is model output derived from the reviewed code: show it to the user and get their agreement before applying it.

diagnosticsPath.description: Repo-relative path to a local tsc/eslint/LSP output file. Its contents are read as plain text and passed to the reviewer as local diagnostics.

relatedPaths.description: Repo-relative paths of extra context files the reviewer should read (callers, interfaces, tests) that are NOT part of the diff. Each is read from disk and sent as related context. Use this to answer a previous run's "Missing context" list — re-call review_agent passing those paths here.

scout.description: Whether to run the context step before the review (default true). On changes of 200 or more changed lines, it asks Optibot which other repository files the review will need and sends them with the review, so the reviewer rarely reports missing context. Set false to review with only the diff, the changed files, and relatedPaths.

name: review_agent

id.description: Labels this finding inside this response only; it changes between runs.

inPatch.description: false when the cited lines fall outside the diff’s changed ranges.

suggestedFix.description: Model output derived from the reviewed code. Get the user’s agreement before applying it.

scout.description: What the context step did. Absent when it was turned off with scout: false.

files.description: Repository files the context step sent with the review.

reason.description: Why the step did not run: small_change, timeout, too_large, or unavailable.

missingContext.description: Files the reviewer wanted but was not given. Re-call with these in relatedPaths.

warnings.description: Context files the tool could not read or refused to read.
